name: Meerbusch (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and yellow in the proportions 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Meerbusch (a red star-shaped figure on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Meerbusch; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Meerbusch arms — red star-shaped figure on yellow
